headline: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Missile as US Warns of Strike Escalation
summary: Saudi air defenses intercepted a missile launched by Houthi forces as former President Trump issued renewed strike warnings, elevating geopolitical tensions across Middle East shipping lanes.
why: Middle Eastern security dynamics directly impact Brent crude benchmarks, marine insurance premiums, and tanker traffic through vital maritime corridors.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Renewed military confrontations in the Arabian Peninsula raise supply disruption risks across regional oil routes.
